saved.normalization: Only archive path in generated source-region comments and the resulting contextual lazy chunk filename are canonicalized. All six asset hashes were compared, and all runtime assertions were rerun.

unknown.normalization: Only archive path in generated source-region comments and the resulting contextual lazy chunk filename are canonicalized. All six asset hashes were compared, and all runtime assertions were rerun.

unknown-mount-all.normalization: Only archive path in generated source-region comments and the resulting contextual lazy chunk filename are canonicalized. All six asset hashes were compared, and all runtime assertions were rerun.

scope: Both variants build in canonical dist with bundled Cesium resources, then execute the repository precache-budget gate. No cache-rule or service-worker filtering is applied by this harness.

The product-index fixture opens the real generated index in isolated Chromium and nonpersistent macOS Tauri/WKWebView and guards storage, outbound networking, and OS notifications prior to startup. The native product test intersects the shipping CSP with a QA-only offline policy.

Late failure removes the synthetic app container after early notice mount, provoking an authentic rejected appStartup promise. Global storage denial keeps mode choices actionable; full-app initialization can remain degraded.

Component fixtures rerun the normal service and shell entry points with guarded sends at the same code SHA; source module prefetch/boot-budget measurements come from the product index, not these harness bundles.

buildComparison.codeTypeChange: BootNotice type alias becomes an interface; emitted entry JS unchanged.
buildComparison.manifestFormat: Sort regular file paths lexicographically; serialize [path, sha256] pairs as compact UTF-8 JSON with no newline and hash with SHA-256. Manifest files reside beside the raw receipts.
